title: STE Doc Rewriter Gold Pair
description: One JSONL line of data/gold/*.jsonl (PLAN_AND_SPEC.md section 11.1).

input.description: Messy technical text as harvested (an excerpt of a row with no detected personal data).

output.description: Strict ASD-STE100 rewrite in Google developer documentation style, with the same facts, APIs and numbers.

protected_spans.description: Distinct spans protect() takes from the input; each must stay identical in the output.

ref.description: Row id plus dataset revision: "<row id>@<commit sha>".

ste_lint_score.description: Repo lint score of the output as a fraction (lint percent / 100).

ste_strict_unapproved.description: Output words that are neither approved ASD-STE100 words nor technical names or verbs (a hand-checked word list; the goal is none).

ste_technical_terms.description: Output words used as technical names or technical verbs instead of approved words, for review.

meaning_ok.description: Meaning check against the input: true when the output keeps every fact of the input and adds none. A pair that fails is rewritten or replaced, never written to the gold file.

meaning_note.description: Short note of the meaning check (what the output keeps, merges or drops as non-fact text).
